static_traits.name: Zhang Ruisen
static_traits.family_status: Has 5 grandchildren, Living alone in a remote cabin
static_traits.social_status: Good relationship with grandchildren, but few daily interpersonal interactions, often feeling Loneliness especially at night
static_traits.medical_history: Never received psychotherapy, No major physical illness; had mild Loneliness after Retired and spouse's death
static_traits.language_features: Slightly nervous seeking help for the first time; clear expression, highly cooperative; organized thinking; able to identify and discuss own negative thought patterns; Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: I persistently believe 'because I live alone in the cabin, I will always be Loneliness', and this thought pattern makes me feel Loneliness and sorrow.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize these feelings of Loneliness are affecting my mental health and overall well-being, prompting me to seek counseling now.
growth_experiences: After my spouse passed away five years ago, the sense of Loneliness markedly intensified; strongest when returning to the empty cabin at night, gradually forming the belief 'I will always be Loneliness'.

After Retired, daily social frequency decreased, and geographic isolation from living in the remote cabin has worsened the sense of Loneliness over time; previously coped mainly through fishing, boating, and Spending time with grandchildren, but with limited effect; never actively sought psychotherapy.

core_beliefs: I am destined to always be Loneliness

special_situations.event: At night, returning alone to a remote small cabin; after activities end, the house is silent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I live alone in the remote cabin, it means my Loneliness is permanent and unchangeable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distracting oneself by going fishing or boating during the day to escape the nighttime sense of Loneliness
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will always be alone, with no way out

special_situations.event: Having almost no social interaction with the outside world that day
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is no interaction with anyone all day, it proves I am isolated with no one to rely on
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Hesitates to contact grandchildren to avoid adding to their burden, instead digesting emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one is willing to accompany me, I can only get through it alone

special_situations.event: Thinking about life after the spouse's death and the current Living alone state
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Losing a partner means I will permanently lose intimate companionship
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Displacing grief and Loneliness over losing the partner with personal hobbies (fishing, boating)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never have an intimate relationship again

special_situations.event: Remote living environment, inconvenient travel and socializing
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Living remotely is doomed to make it hard to build or maintain social connections
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not yet actively learning about local fishing groups or woodworking communities, coping mainly through Being alone activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I have no social opportunities, this place will only make me more Loneliness

core_conflict.wish: Longing for stable intimate companionship and emotional connection
core_conflict.fear: Fearing becoming a burden to family; fearing endless Loneliness
defense_goal: Reduces dependence on others through self-restraint, avoiding proactively seeking help to maintain inner security
Interpreting the choice of not seeking support with environmental and practical reasons, reducing the Sense of guilt about Being rejected or disturbing others

object_relations.self_representation: A Loneliness / Widowed person unwilling to trouble others
object_relations.object_representation: Family members are busy, limited support (visits not frequent)

object_relations.self_representation: A grieving person who lost an intimate relationship
object_relations.object_representation: The environment is a cold, isolated space (remote small cabin)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing seeking more support from grandchildren or increasing social contact
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client believes proactively contacting others will trouble them, thus tending toward self-restraint
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Euphemistic tone, emphasizing the other is busy and should not be disturbed; avoiding direct specific requests, using vague expressions and polite Self-denial to weaken the request for help.

manifestations: After Widowed, Living alone in the remote cabin, the sense of Loneliness strongest in the quiet night
Low social frequency, reduced interaction with the outside; heavier sense of Loneliness on days lacking interaction
Hesitates to express himself to family and seek support, worried about becoming a burden
outcomes: Pessimistic Anticipation about future social possibilities
Evening routine affected (Low mood, Decreased drive)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: Hesitating to contact my grandchildren for fear of becoming a burden, suppressing the urge to seek help back into myself
Internally digesting Loneliness and sorrow through Being alone activities (fishing, boating), rather than outwardly seeking support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Overly cautious about seeking help, limits the frequency of interaction with family
Constrains expressing needs with the reason 'they are busy'

exception_events.target_problem: When Being alone in the cabin at night, the client typically falls into ruminative thinking of 'I will always be Loneliness' and feels intense Loneliness and sorrow.
exception_events.unique_outcome: On the evening spent with the grandchildren, the client did not immerse in the 'always Loneliness' thought as usual, but felt happy, with the sense of Loneliness markedly reduced.
exception_events.reason: Different support: interacting with family brings emotional connection; different situation: social interaction that day; different actions: actively gathering with family, gaining positive experience.

positive_force: Good relationship with grandchildren, a source of emotional support exists
Has hobbies such as fishing, boating, and woodworking, which can serve as entry points for behavioral activation and social participation
Willing to seek help and change; positive attitude
Able to identify and willing to challenge negative thought patterns
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking, tending to view Loneliness as a permanent state
Overgeneralization and predicting the future, lowering expectations of social possibilities
Remote living environment leads to objectively limited social opportunities
Hesitates to seek support, worried about becoming a burden to family

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly falling into negative rumination of 'I will always be Loneliness' at night and experiencing marked Loneliness and sorrow
antecedent: Quiet inside after returning to the remote cabin at night
Little interaction with others that day
Thinking about the spouse's death and the current Living alone state
target_behavior.core_reason: Reduced socializing after Widowed and Retired, isolated living environment, and negative Automatic thoughts from catastrophizing and black-and-white cognitions about Loneliness maintaining the rumination.
target_behavior.function: Gaining 'certainty' through self-assertion, avoiding the Anxiety and uncertainty of outwardly seeking support in the short term; replacing real contact with rumination.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened Loneliness and sorrow, decreased quality of life in the evening, maintaining and Reinforcing the belief 'I am destined to always be Loneliness'.
